title: A browser base-defence game written with AI tools, designed and tuned by playing it (free open beta)
author: lnkkonito
selftext:
Hello! Rock & Hold is a dig-and-defend game for the browser, phone or desktop: dig into a mountain by day, hold your hearth by night.

How it is made: I decide the rules and play every build, and AI tools write the code. Every sprite is SVG drawn in code and the sound is synthesised with WebAudio. Bots of four skill levels play the game to check its balance, and every design decision is logged with its reason (over 600 so far).

Play: [https://rockandhold.com](https://rockandhold.com)

Happy to answer anything about the process. What would you want to know?

Made with AI: I design the game and tune it by playing it; the code, art and sound are written with AI tools.

replies.author: lnkkonito
replies.body: Thanks ! Looking forward to reading your feedback! Let me know your thoughts!
